# Yahoo Sports Canada

> > Sports news, scores, and entertainment content for Canadian audiences, featuring coverage of NHL, Premier League, Formula 1, and integrated TV Guide listings for streaming services like Netflix, HBO, and Paramount+.

Yahoo Sports Canada serves as a comprehensive sports and entertainment portal, combining breaking sports news from leagues like NHL and Premier League with TV Guide's streaming recommendations and entertainment coverage. The site also features lifestyle content and shopping guides alongside its core sports reporting.

## Key Topics

- NHL (St. Louis Blues, Buffalo Sabres)
- Premier League (Liverpool, West Bromwich Albion)
- Formula 1 sponsorships
- Netflix streaming content
- TV Guide listings and schedules
- Streaming services (HBO, Paramount+, Peacock, Prime Video, Hulu)
- Yellowstone franchise
- Game of Thrones universe
- Star Trek series
- Entertainment news and celebrity coverage
- Movie recommendations and Oscar nominees
- Canadian sports coverage
- Fantasy sports games
- Winter TV season programming

## Core Pages

- [Yahoo Sports Canada Homepage](https://ca.sports.yahoo.com): Yahoo Sports Canada homepage with news, scores, and fantasy games
- [TV Guide Homepage](https://tvguide.com): TV Guide homepage with streaming recommendations and entertainment news
- [TV Listings](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV Guide listings and schedules for shows, movies, and programs by provider
- [Live Sports Schedule](https://tvguide.com/sports/live-today): Daily live sports schedule across MLB, NBA, NHL, and international leagues
